# harborpilot_quota_adapters (Data Source)

Lists the quota adapters a `harborpilot_quota_monitor` can use, with their tier (`official`, `unofficial`, …).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harborpilot_quota_adapters" "all" {}

output "official_adapters" {
  value = [for a in data.harborpilot_quota_adapters.all.adapters : a.id if a.tier == "official"]
}
```
